records.title: Transformer FFNs Are Key-Value Memories
records.observed_mechanism: W1 modes induce feature activation; W2 sums learned value vectors
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Video FFN value vectors may be features in superposition rather than one neuron/semantic role

records.title: Toy Models of Superposition
records.observed_mechanism: Sparse features can superpose in non-neuron-aligned coordinates
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Do not assume individual Wan GELU neurons equal independent scene features

records.title: Sparsing Law: Towards LLMs with Greater Activation Sparsity
records.observed_mechanism: Sparsity robustness depends on task and training architecture
records.wan_specific_discriminator: CETT/PPL quality and ReLU/SiLU trends do not transfer unmodified to Wan tanh-GELU

records.title: FLAP: Fluctuation-Based Adaptive Structured Pruning
records.observed_mechanism: Recoverable feature fluctuation, structured selection and mean compensation
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Selected original nonlinear columns + fitted residual readout is close to known FLAP/regression principles

records.title: Wanda: A Simple and Effective Pruning Approach
records.observed_mechanism: Weight magnitude multiplied by observed input activation selects sparse weights
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Weight-activation score is not guaranteed functional necessity or GPU speed in four-step I2V

records.title: SliceGPT: Compress LLMs by Deleting Rows and Columns
records.observed_mechanism: Computational invariance enables narrow dense networks under specific transformations
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Nonlinear GELU and QDQ prevent arbitrary hidden basis rotations from being free

records.title: Universal Properties of Activation Sparsity in Modern LLMs
records.observed_mechanism: Model scale and architecture affect FFN sparsity robustness
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Diffusion LLM with masked tokens is not a video DiT

records.title: RT-Lynx: Putting GEMM Sparsity in the Right Place for Diffusion Models
records.observed_mechanism: Activation N:M more robust than weight N:M; norm compensation and light LoRA
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Original full paper/code not reviewed; N:M activated GEMM and error compensation verified by abstract only. Third-party norm/LoRA formula requires primary verification; after-GELU sparsity does not save already-done W1.

records.title: Chipmunk: Dynamic Column-Sparse Deltas
records.observed_mechanism: Sparse inter-step change of MLP and attention scaled value vectors; voxel reorder
records.decision_time: previous-step cached activation/output plus current reduced-token blockmean passed through fc1; topk mask on blockmean activation difference
records.physical_action: column sparse delta GEMM and cache
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Original MLP implementation computes blockmean-W1 to choose mask and uses a separate >=10-step mask-cache reuse condition. Original Wan2.1 long-step performance is not four-step Wan2.2 evidence.

records.title: Dense2MoE: Restructuring DiT to MoE
records.observed_mechanism: Preserves total FFN capacity while selecting activated experts and blocks
records.physical_action: subset of FFN experts and blocks
records.wan_specific_discriminator: MoE+MoB conditional capacity is learned by multi-stage distillation; original high/low Wan denoisers are not per-token internal MoE. Detailed router/loss require original full method check.

records.title: OBS-Diff: Accurate One-Shot Pruning for Diffusion
records.observed_mechanism: Timestep-aware Hessian motivated by accumulation; supports FFN neurons and N:M
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Hessian/time weighting is its mechanism-derived tool, not a universal semantic objective

records.title: Activation Concentration: Column-Level Output Sparsity Across Diffusion Architectures
records.observed_mechanism: Element zero rate overestimates actually empty columns; layout and thresholds matter
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Element sparsity vs simulated systolic column sparsity; reported DiT 12.4% cycle reduction cannot be transferred as actual Wan BF16 or FP4 sparse GEMM speed.

records.title: TinyFusion: Diffusion Transformers Learned Shallow
records.observed_mechanism: Immediate low calibration loss fails to predict after-finetuning recovery; learns recoverability
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Motivates function/quality targets before SSE; does not demonstrate training-free FFN sparsity

records.title: TeaCache: Timestep Embedding Tells Its Time to Cache
records.observed_mechanism: Cheap timestep-modulated input difference predicts expensive output difference
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Wan only four steps, expert switch and CFG false require conditional validation

records.title: AdaCache: Adaptive Caching for Video DiTs
records.observed_mechanism: Content and motion heterogeneity guide cache budgets
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Static appearing background does not establish FFN dispensability or no flicker

records.title: Accelerating DiTs with Token-wise Feature Caching (ToCa)
records.observed_mechanism: Some tokens much more sensitive to caching; cache granularity varies by layer
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Compare old light/background failures and true FFN-level rather than token-only control

records.title: ProfilingDiT: Model Reveals What to Cache
records.observed_mechanism: Foreground/background oriented block functions and step variation
records.wan_specific_discriminator: FFNDS background lighting failures contradict simplistic background=unimportant rule

records.title: FasterCache: Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration
records.observed_mechanism: Naive adjacent feature reuse loses subtle changes; CFG branch redundancy exploited
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Current distilled Wan has CFG disabled so only non-CFG parts transfer

records.title: DiffSparse: Learned Token Sparsity for DiT
records.model: PixArt-alpha 20 steps, DiT-XL/2 50 steps, FLUX.1-schnell 4 steps, Wan2.1-1.3B text-to-video 25 flow steps
records.observed_mechanism: Learn layer-wise sparsity with end-to-end optimizer for few-step caches
records.decision_time: trained offline per-step/per-layer cost allocation; online token priority plus cached layer features
records.training: two-stage AdamW offline cost matrix optimization; STE; full-sampling LPIPS distillation; 8 AMD MI250 4-10h per experiment
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Wan2.1-1.3B T2V experiment was 25 steps; 4-step was FLUX.1-schnell T2I; neither is four-step Wan2.2 I2V FFN neuron sparsity.

records.title: BWCache: Block-Wise Caching for Video DiT
records.observed_mechanism: Observed U-shaped block variation prompts block cache trigger
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Four-step expert schedule may not exhibit multi-step U-shape

records.title: HyCa: Let Features Decide Their Own Solvers
records.observed_mechanism: Feature dimensions show heterogeneous dynamical evolution resembling mixture of ODEs
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Time interpolation limited by only four steps and expert changes

records.title: MosaicDiff: Structural Pruning Reflecting Pretraining Dynamics
records.observed_mechanism: Pretraining phase learning dynamics informs stage-aware sparse models
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Pretraining stages and denoising stages cannot be conflated without source review

records.title: Sparse VideoGen: Spatial–Temporal Sparse Video Attention
records.observed_mechanism: Spatial/temporal attention head motifs and online classification
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Attention patterns not FFN masks; borrow discovery→cheap classifier→kernel process

records.title: Sparse-vDiT: Sparse Attention for Video DiT
records.observed_mechanism: Attention head topology has partial input stability and layer specificity
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Do not equate attention pattern stability with GELU output stability

records.title: SVOO: Attention Sparsity Is Input-Stable
records.observed_mechanism: Offline per-layer sparsity plus online QK co-clustering
records.wan_specific_discriminator: QK interaction has no direct W1/GELU counterpart

records.title: DFSAttn: Dynamic Fine-Grained Sparse Attention
records.observed_mechanism: Fine dynamic sparsity may defeat coarse block recall despite low attention density
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Conflicting layer stability conditions must be measured in Wan FFN separately

records.title: SLA: Sparse-Linear Attention for DiT
records.observed_mechanism: High-rank sparse critical weights and low-rank marginal attention differ
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Suggests heterogeneous solvers but not proven FFN basis decomposition

records.title: QuantSparse: Video DiT Quantization and Attention Sparsification
records.observed_mechanism: Quantization+attention sparsity interact; multi-scale distillation and second-order residual
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Attention quantization effects and HiF4 FFN Q2 dependencies are not interchangeable

records.title: VBench: Comprehensive Video Generation Benchmark
records.observed_mechanism: Separates subject/background consistency, flicker, motion and dynamic degree
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Keep functional quality components separate from global proxy/SSE

records.title: VMBench: Perception-Aligned Motion Generation Benchmark
records.observed_mechanism: Motion quality must be aligned with perceptual dimensions
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Farneback proxy alone cannot support real motion fidelity acceptance

records.title: NVIDIA NVFP4 Official Format and Scaling
records.observed_mechanism: E2M1 with E4M3 block and FP32 global scales; packed layouts change real cost
records.wan_specific_discriminator: FFNDS successful synthetic CUTLASS primitive is not a Wan kernel or arithmetic reduction

records.title: Efficient Video Diffusion Models: Advancements and Challenges
records.observed_mechanism: Classifies distillation, attention, compression, and cache/trajectory approaches
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Use only as citation discovery; cite original experiments for claims

records.title: Efficient Diffusion Models: A Survey
records.observed_mechanism: Algorithm/systems/framework compression and acceleration taxonomy
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Secondary map not independent evidence for every included result

records.title: Dynamic-in-Few-Step: Unifying Dynamic Computation and Few-Step Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
records.model: Wan-14B 4-step; variant not pinned in abstract
records.observed_mechanism: Joint stage-specific structured sparsification and few-step distillation yielding Mixture-of-Models with progressive training and output rollout
records.decision_time: offline schedule and trained step-specific submodels
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Closest four-step large Wan structural competitor; 24% per-step FLOP reduction, 1.2x extra wall are author numbers; does not identify intrinsic FFN neuron role

records.title: FIS-DiT: Breaking the Few-Step Video Inference Barrier via Training-Free Frame Interleaved Sparsity
records.observed_mechanism: Interleaves latent frame subsets across model hierarchy; refreshes all frame positions across blocks despite partial-frame execution
records.decision_time: spatial-temporal frame indices and layer schedule, not step-history delta
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Direct Wan2.2 few-step attention+FFN operator-agnostic competitor; does not show FFN channel sparsity; official code not yet publicly located in host repo

records.title: PARE: Pruning and Adaptive Routing for Efficient Video Generation
records.observed_mechanism: Motion-aware attention-head width pruning plus learned per-step/content-conditioned block router
records.decision_time: router consumes timestep and visual content
records.physical_action: pruned attention width and dynamically skipped blocks
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Strong adaptive-depth competitor on I2V Wan; attention head widths not FFN channels; routing training/nontrivial overhead

records.title: Taming Diffusion Transformer for Efficient Mobile Video Generation in Seconds
records.observed_mechanism: KD-guided tri-level block/head/FFN-channel sensitivity pruning with adversarial 4-step distillation and compressed VAE
records.physical_action: physically smaller FFN width and blocks
records.wan_specific_discriminator: The closest true FFN-channel structural pruning baseline, but multi-part mobile speed cannot be attributed to FFN alone

records.title: FastLightGen: Fast and Light Video Generation with Fewer Steps and Parameters
records.observed_mechanism: Rank non-critical blocks, probabilistic dynamic pruning then joint size-step distribution distillation
records.physical_action: block-depth pruning and fewer denoise steps
records.wan_specific_discriminator: 4-step/30% pruning includes block+step changes; do not infer F1 FFN selective neuron redundancy

records.title: Forecast the Principal, Stabilize the Residual (SVD-Cache)
records.observed_mechanism: Principal subspace smooth and predictable but low-energy residual temporally oscillatory; EMA principal, cache residual
records.decision_time: offline one-time SVD and previous feature cache
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Competes directly with any claim that low-energy FFN modes can be omitted without temporal consequence; announced GitHub repo essentially empty in checked snapshot

records.title: ProCache: Constraint-Aware Feature Caching with Selective Computation for DiT
records.observed_mechanism: Offline constrained heterogeneous cache schedule plus selective computation in important deep blocks/tokens
records.decision_time: offline sampling, cached state and token salience
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Deep-block restoration not FFN function selectivity; near competitor to function-dependent compute schedule

records.title: BLADE: Block-Sparse Attention Meets Step Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
records.observed_mechanism: Content-aware adaptive block sparse attention integrated during step distillation
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Strong joint optimization precedent on Wan1.3B but attention is not FFN; speed relative to 50-step cannot be cited as extra per-step gain

records.title: Veda: Scalable Video Diffusion via Distilled Sparse Attention
records.observed_mechanism: Attention quality governed by matched full-attention tile geometry; tile scoring/head-aware tiling and sparse tile kernel
records.decision_time: offline mask distillation and online tile selection
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Tile shape→quality observation is an analog, not evidence FFN Fourier modes define valuable compute

records.title: Pluggable Pruning with Contiguous Layer Distillation (PPCL)
records.observed_mechanism: Find contiguous redundant layers via linear probing; teacher/student alternating distillation for depth and width in one phase
records.physical_action: width and contiguous depth physical pruning
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Requires trained recovery and mostly images, not original Wan FFN sparse conditional functions

records.title: Neodragon: Mobile Video Generation Using Diffusion Transformer
records.observed_mechanism: Block pruning plus text encoder/VAE compression and extended DMD step distillation
records.physical_action: whole-block cut + step count, compressed VAE
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Mobile full pipeline can hide FFN-specific cost and temporal texture impact

records.title: Test-time Sparsity for Extreme Fast Action Diffusion
records.observed_mechanism: Runtime predictor for prunable residual compute with reused previous step and rollout features; parallel overlap to amortize selector cost
records.decision_time: shared cheap encoder and multi-timescale cache
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Strong information-timing and predictor-cost neighbor, but action policy data/costs not Wan video quality

records.title: Transition Matching Distillation for Fast Video Generation
records.observed_mechanism: Decompose backbone early semantic extractor and final flow head with inner rollout; distribution matching of transitions
records.physical_action: less repeated backbone, conditional flow head
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Functional layer roles and suffix dependencies are relevant but this is architecture/step repurposing, not FFN neuron sparsity

records.title: Adaptive Video Distillation: Mitigating Oversaturation and Temporal Collapse
records.observed_mechanism: Adaptive regression and explicit temporal regularization to prevent few-step low-dynamic quality
records.training: DMD with regularization and optional SFT
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Provides explicit quality failure mode competing with FFN local error explanation; no direct sparse FFN mechanism

records.title: Attention Surgery: An Efficient Recipe to Linearize Your Video Diffusion Transformer
records.observed_mechanism: Hybrid linear+softmax attention with layer rate selected by physical cost and lightweight distillation
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Shows functional decomposition into distinct operators, not proof FFN GELU splits analogously

records.title: SPRINT: Sparse–Dense Residual Fusion for Efficient DiT
records.observed_mechanism: Shallow dense detail plus deep sparse tokens fused by residual; train sparse then restore full tokens; PDG inference
records.decision_time: during training with selected token subset
records.physical_action: sparse deep blocks and residual fusion
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Training-time token structure and inference guidance differ from Wan sparse FFN; motivates preserving context via dense/sparse paths

records.title: NerVE: Nonlinear Eigenspectrum Dynamics in LLM Feed-Forward Networks
records.observed_mechanism: GELU and other FFN nonlinearities reinject variance across eigendirections; spectral entropy and effective dimension shift
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Actual FFN nonlinearity changes function rank; cov-spectrum is diagnostic, not feature causality or an online sparse decision

records.title: CineMobile: On-Device I2V Diffusion for Cinematic Camera Motion
records.observed_mechanism: Distillation-guided structured depth pruning, four-step DMD+RL and mixed W4A16/FP8 precision
records.physical_action: pruned blocks, four-step sampler and 4bit FFN weights
records.wan_specific_discriminator: FFN W4 weight precision is not W4A4 and not FFN arithmetic sparsity; author system-level 40x not isolate FFN
